note: Examples of good follow-up questions, used as prompt examples when the doctor-like interview is on. The first ones are hand-written for the demo, not from doctors. Reviewed doctor feedback (the 'Anything you wish had been asked?' answers) is added with source 'doctor_feedback' only after a person checks it. No fine-tuning until there is reviewed real data.

examples.patient_said: Kabhi kabhi sar dard hota hai
examples.good_question: Samajh gaya. Hafte mein kitni baar sar dard hota hai?
I understand. From 1 to 10, how bad is the pain at its worst?

examples.patient_said: मुझे तीन दिन से बुखार है
examples.good_question: धन्यवाद। क्या बुखार के साथ ठंड लगती है या कंपकंपी होती है?
Thank you. Do you know the name of the tablet, and how many times a day you take it?
